failure_policy: Stop on the first failure and preserve every contact. No retry, no scoring, no partial quality read. A failed smoke stops CELL-3 and the 1,000-row arm does not open; the twin smoke gates the twin arm the same way. At most ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration, which needs BOTH a new generation attempt id AND a new native_contact_fit.attempt_id; a second failure stops the flight and the fix is proven on a four-row offline dry run.
